name: Alignment Tax and Exogenous Constraint Scaling
definition: External control scales against capability, so oversight cost rises faster than the capability it constrains.
trigger_conditions: Alignment relies on constraint imposed from outside the agent's incentive structure
Agent capability is expected to increase
No endogenous stake grows with capability
